shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "pwd; git status --short --branch; rg --files -g 'AGENTS.md' -g '*tdd-loop*' -g 'reanchor.mjs' -g '.lore/test-commands.yml'; sed -n '1,240p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts; sed -n '1,220p' specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md; cat .lore/test-commands.yml; command -v lore-query-trace || true"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "cat AGENTS.md; rg --files src/orchestration | rg 'chatOrchestrator.*test'; sed -n '1,140p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.beforeSession.acceptance.test.ts; sed -n '1,240p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts; cat package.json; rg --files scripts/spec-links"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n 'specs/.*#[0-9]+|spec anchor|VALIDATED_BY|spec:' src scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs | head -70; sed -n '1,180p' scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs; sed -n '1,100p' CHANGELOG.md; rg -n 'beforeSession|afterSession|onError' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git diff --check; git diff --stat; git diff -- src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md CHANGELOG.md .lore/dod.md; nl -ba src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.beforeSession.test.ts | head -12; nl -ba src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.beforeSession.acceptance.test.ts | sed -n '37,42p'; git status --short"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git diff --check; git add .lore/dod.md CHANGELOG.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.beforeSession.test.ts; git commit -m 'fix(orchestrator): run cleanup after session setup fails' -m 'Fixes #94'"
